CLAIM: CLM-2026-10001  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-03-14  
POLICY LINE: homeowners  
GOVERNING FORM: HO-0304 ed. 03-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: COVERED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $1,000  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: NONE  
SUMMARY: The loss resulted from a “sudden and accidental” rupture of a plumbing supply line, which is not excluded under E-17 and is therefore covered subject to the policy deductible [structure_aware:HO-0304:HO-0304-ed-03-24.md:0007 | HO-0304 ed. 03-24 | SECTION I — EXCLUSIONS / E-17]. A single deductible of $1,000 applies per water loss occurrence [structure_aware:HO-0304:HO-0304-ed-03-24.md:0013 | HO-0304 ed. 03-24 | SECTION I — CONDITIONS APPLICABLE TO THIS ENDORSEMENT]. The repair costs of $8,500 are therefore payable less the deductible.

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10002
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-04-03
POLICY LINE: homeowners
GOVERNING FORM: HO-0304 ed. 03-24
COVERAGE POSITION: DENIED
DEDUCTIBLE: $1,000
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: E-15
SUMMARY: The loss resulted from river flood water overtopping its bank and entering the home, which is classified as flood, surface water, or overflow of a body of water. Flood is expressly excluded under exclusion E-15 [structure_aware:HO-0304:HO-0304-ed-03-24.md:0002 | HO-0304 ed. 03-24 | SECTION I — EXCLUSIONS / E-15]. Consequently the policy does not provide coverage for the claimed damages.

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10003  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-06-02  
POLICY LINE: homeowners  
GOVERNING FORM: HO-0304 ed. 03-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: DENIED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $1,000  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: E-19  
SUMMARY: The water damage resulted from a continuously leaking cold water supply fitting that had been escaping for approximately three weeks, which triggers exclusion E-19 for continuous or repeated seepage lasting 14 days or more [0006 | HO-0304 | E-19]. Because the loss is excluded, the claim is denied despite the presence of a $1,000 deductible provision for water losses [0013 | HO-0304 | Deductible].

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10004  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-02-20  
POLICY LINE: dwelling_fire  
GOVERNING FORM: DP-0110 ed. 02-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: DENIED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $1,500  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: E-17  
SUMMARY: The loss resulted from a burst washing-machine supply hose, which is water damage from the discharge, rupture, or burst of a plumbing supply line within the dwelling. Under the dwelling-fire form, such damage is excluded by exclusion E-17 with no exception for sudden rupture [structure_aware:DP-0110:DP-0110-ed-02-24.md:0002 | DP-0110 ed. 02-24 | SECTION I — EXCLUSIONS / E-17]. Consequently, the claim is denied.

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10005  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-05-09  
POLICY LINE: condo  
GOVERNING FORM: CO-0715 ed. 04-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: COVERED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $250  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: NONE  
SUMMARY: The $3,000 special assessment is for repair of the roof, a direct physical loss to property owned collectively by the association caused by a windstorm, which is a peril insured against under SECTION I of the policy [structure_aware:CO-0715:CO-0715-ed-04-24.md:0002 | CO-0715 ed. 04-24 | SECTION I — LOSS ASSESSMENT COVERAGE]. The assessment is not for the association’s deductible, earthquake, water-damage maintenance failure, or capital improvements, so none of the listed exclusions (E-31, E-32, E-33, E-34) apply [structure_aware:CO-0715:CO-0715-ed-04-24.md:0005 | CO-0715 ed. 04-24 | SECTION I — EXCLUSIONS APPLICABLE TO LOSS ASSESSMENT / E-33]. A $250 deductible applies to each loss assessment, which is applied to this loss.

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10006  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-01-18  
POLICY LINE: condo  
GOVERNING FORM: CO-0715 ed. 04-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: DENIED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $250  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: E-31  
SUMMARY: The assessment of $2,500 was levied to fund the association’s master policy deductible, which is excluded under assessment exclusion code E-31 [structure_aware:CO-0715:CO-0715-ed-04-24.md:0004 | CO-0715 ed. 04-24 | SECTION I — EXCLUSIONS APPLICABLE TO LOSS ASSESSMENT / E-31]. Because the cause of the assessment is the master policy deductible, the loss assessment coverage does not apply. The policy provides a $250 deductible per assessment, but the claim is denied on the exclusion ground.

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10007
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-04-11
POLICY LINE: homeowners
GOVERNING FORM: HO-0304 ed. 03-24
COVERAGE POSITION: DENIED
DEDUCTIBLE: $1,000
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: E-20
SUMMARY: The loss resulted from municipal sewer backup through the basement floor drain, which is excluded under exclusion E-20 and no backup endorsement is on file [structure_aware:HO-0304:HO-0304-ed-03-24.md:0007 | HO-0304 ed. 03-24 | SECTION I — EXCLUSIONS / E-20]. Consequently the claim is denied, subject only to the policy deductible.

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10008
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-05-27
POLICY LINE: homeowners
GOVERNING FORM: HO-0521 ed. 06-24
COVERAGE POSITION: PARTIAL
DEDUCTIBLE: $500
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: NONE
SUMMARY: The loss involves theft of a diamond engagement ring ($4,200) and a gold necklace ($1,800) for a total claimed amount of $6,000. Under the special limits for jewelry, watches, and precious stones, coverage is limited to $2,500 per loss [structure_aware:HO-0521:HO-0521-ed-06-24.md:0004 | HO-0521 ed. 06-24 | B. Other special limits]. The policy deductible of $500 applies to the loss. The claim is therefore partially covered up to the $2,500 limit, less the deductible.

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10009  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-07-08  
POLICY LINE: homeowners  
GOVERNING FORM: HO-0304 ed. 03-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: UNDETERMINED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $1,000  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: NONE  
SUMMARY: The loss is a water damage claim in the kitchen with a claimed amount of $11,000. Coverage depends on whether the water loss is caused by a “sudden and accidental” rupture of a plumbing supply line (covered under E-17) or by continuous/repeated seepage lasting 14 days or more (excluded under E-19) or another excluded peril such as flood (E-15) or underground water (E-16) [0006 | HO-0304 | E-19]. The adjuster’s notes do not specify the cause or duration of the water loss, so the applicable exclusion cannot be identified. Additional information on the source, timing, and nature of the water escape is needed to determine coverage.

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10010  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-03-02  
POLICY LINE: condo  
GOVERNING FORM: CO-0715 ed. 04-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: DENIED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $250  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: E-33  
SUMMARY: The policy provides loss-assessment coverage up to $50,000 with a $250 deductible per assessment [structure_aware:CO-0715:CO-0715-ed-04-24.md:0002 | CO-0715 ed. 04-24 | SECTION I — LOSS ASSESSMENT COVERAGE]. However, the assessment arises from water damage to the collectively owned plumbing where the association failed to maintain the system, which is excluded under code E-33 [structure_aware:CO-0715:CO-0715-ed-04-24.md:0005 | CO-0715 ed. 04-24 | SECTION I — EXCLUSIONS APPLICABLE TO LOSS ASSESSMENT / E-33]. Consequently, the claim is denied.

CLAIM: CLAIM_ID
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-04-03
POLICY LINE: homeowners
GOVERNING FORM: HO-0304 ed. 03-24
COVERAGE POSITION: DENIED
DEDUCTIBLE: $750
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: E-22
SUMMARY: The loss resulted from rain entering through an opening in the roof that was created by the insured’s own repair work, not by a covered peril, and therefore falls under exclusion E-22 which denies coverage for water damage caused by rain soaking a roof, deck, or exterior wall through an opening not created by a covered peril [0009 | HO-0304 ed. 03-24 | SECTION I — EXCLUSIONS / E-22]. The policy deductible of $750 applies to the loss, but the claim is denied on the basis of the exclusion.
